migration.detail: Spec §8 applied to RIVET_OPERATION_CONTRACTS.md before the loop: customer_ref split into account/contact/location refs, I1 deepened to tenant→Account→Contact/Location, new I14 read-time entitlement, CUS-001/002 three-way dedupe + per-entity edit scope, #6 merge gated on D16 (Account-level merge forbidden by voice), #7 first-class Location, INB-002 Location resolution, MSG-001/002 contact resolution + entitlement + explicit cross-channel selection, INV/EST/PAY billing-contact recipient, vectors V19–V23 added.

C1.detail: Timeline reads pinned to tenant_id + single customerId (customers/timeline-service.ts); no parent/sub-account merge on reads; shared inbound phone routes to sms_unmatched thread, never attributed by ranking (sms/inbound-capture.ts); portal exposes no timeline route.

C2.detail: Was FAIL: portal sessions were customer-level bearer tokens; contact roles never consulted; any token holder could read invoices/balances/payment methods. Now: portal_sessions.contact_id (migration 262), entitlement derived from the contact's CURRENT role at token resolution (portal/portal-entitlement.ts — primary/billing→billing surface, site/other→service surface, D19 default-deny), contact-bound tokens fail closed on missing/archived/moved contact, billing routes (invoices, estimates, agreements, payment-methods) gated via requirePortalEntitlement. Residual: contacts are not yet Location-scoped, so a service-entitled contact sees all of the customer's jobs/appointments, not just their property — needs the full Account/Contact/Location schema (D19).

C3.detail: Was FAIL: reply channel defaulted from customer.preferredChannel (not the thread), with silent cross-channel flips when the preferred address was missing; recipient always customer-level primaryPhone/email. Now: replies resolve within their own channel thread (bounded findLatestInboundChannel lookup), thread-derived channel switches require explicit selection (channel_selection_required / HTTP 409), preference-derived defaults may fall through only to the single deliverable channel (deterministic, not a guess). Residual: sends still target customer-record primaryPhone/email — per-Contact recipient targeting (V19) needs the full Contact model on the send path.

C4.detail: No commitment extraction exists. summarize-session produces prose summary + intent only; call_summaries has no action-item field; no task creation from transcripts; no low-confidence review queue. Build plan: extend summarize-session extraction with confidence-scored commitments, commitments table linked to source timeline entry, high-confidence→task, low-confidence→operator review queue, nothing silently discarded (V23).

C5.detail: Was FAIL on ordering: Gather TwiML prepended <Start><Record> before the disclosure <Say>; media-streams opened Deepgram ASR before the disclosure played. Now: Gather emits the record block AFTER the first <Say> (disclosure is inside it; <Gather> ASR already followed); media-streams gates frame-forwarding to ASR behind captureEnabled, set on the greeting turn's end-of-utterance mark ack (disclosure fully played), with a 30s lost-ack fallback and fail-open on disclosure-init failure (existing never-hang-up policy; DISCLOSURE_INIT_FAILED alert is the compliance signal). Residual: caller barge-in during the greeting is no longer transcribed on the stream path (pre-consent audio is dropped by design); disclosure copy still flagged 'legal review required' (D15).

C6.detail: Was FAIL: retention sweep deleted only audio (kept transcripts/summaries/embeddings); tenant deprovision deleted DB rows but orphaned S3 audio; no per-customer erasure. Now: retention sweep purges all four classes per recording in one tenant-scoped transaction (call_transcript_turns, call_summaries, knowledge_chunks incl. :window ids, transcript columns nulled) before the tombstone, counts audited; deprovision captures files keys pre-purge and deletes stored objects post-commit (counts in platform log). Residual: no customer-level DSAR/right-to-erasure entry point yet — deletion currently reaches everything only via retention clock or full tenant purge (D17).

C7.detail: Inbound email does not exist: no inbound-parse webhook, no Message-ID/In-Reply-To/References threading, no From-address matching, no unmatched-sender review queue, no attachment scanning/caps. Outbound email sends via SendGrid but has no suppression-list enforcement, and no bounce/complaint processing ('bounced' status is dead schema). I13 provenance would apply automatically IF inbound email lands as messages rows with senderRole='customer' — must be pinned when built (V21).

C8.detail: Voice/AI history reads go through reducing skills (summarize-customer-history caps + counts; voice-lookup-answer emits counts/highlights). The enumerating getCustomerTimeline (200-event cap) is reachable only from the Clerk-authed staff route, not voice. Structural caveat: reduction is per-skill, not a single enforced choke point.
